feeds.title: Canal Boat Magazine
feeds.description: Packed with important information and fascinating facts, Canal Boat was launched in 1996. With insights from our liveaboard diaries, expert boat reviews, and news coverage plus cruise guides and invaluable technical advice, Canal Boat's busy itinerary equips readers for their next adventure.

feeds.title: HERBIE!
feeds.description: Greetings! This travel blog where HERBIE! and her fellow shipmates share their experiences about the journeys on the narrowboat and the trials and tribulations of maintaining her.

feeds.title: Hadar
feeds.description: Hello! We are Keith & Jo and welcome to our blog. The blog is about all our travel experiences as we venture through various canals of the United Kingdom. We even occasionally sell greeting cards and crochet-work and just enjoy our lives to the fullest!

feeds.title: Michael Tyler
feeds.description: Hi! I am Michael and welcome to my personal blog.This blog documents my narrowboat adventures and various experiences of my journey as I venture through the canals of the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Narrowboat World
feeds.description: Get the latest news, canal boat holiday guides, articles, forum, emails, gallery, advice, and discussion. The narrowboat world is a waterways newspaper and has been one of the most read newspapers and has also been placed among the most influential waterways publications.

feeds.title: Fox Narrowboats Blog
feeds.description: Greetings from Team Fox! Welcome to our blog where we post news, articles, travel experiences, and some valuable knowledge on narrowboats. Fox Narrowboats is a narrowboat build and hire, family-run business. In addition to providing boating holidays and day boat hire, we have a fully serviced, secure boating marina with 200 moorings.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Briar Rose
feeds.description: Welcome to the Narrowboat Briar Rose blog, where we intend to share the details of our travels on Briar Rose, as well as other waterways-related posts.

feeds.title: Drifters Boating Holiday Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Drifters Blog, where we present information as well as travel experience on narrow-boating. Drifters Waterway Holidays offer 580 canal boats for hire from 45 bases across the UK. Drifters members aim to work together to promote canal boat holidays, encourage best practices, and lobby navigation authorities and trade associations on issues affecting the hire boat trade

feeds.title: Captain Ahab's Watery Tales
feeds.description: Hi! This is Andy aka 'Captain Ahab'. My blog is An online logbook of watery wanderings and something of a 'go-to' location for information about lost canals.

feeds.title: Barry & Sandra's Adventures Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Barry and Sandra. Welcome to our blog, which is all about Inspirational Travel Writing & Photography. It is about our life and adventures on and off our narrowboat.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Firecrest Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cheryl, I am a registered nurse and have been working for Marie Curie, a most humbling and satisfying career. This blog is about 'Coddiwompling' with Narrowboat 'Firecrest'.It's about our beloved Firecrest and how we're adapting from living on the land in a 'proper house' to living afloat.

feeds.title: Boutique Narrowboats Blog
feeds.description: The Boutique Narrowboats concept was borne out of a love of five-star hotels as well as the canals and it seems that many of you felt the same way. A Boutique Narrowboat adventure includes all the elements of a romantic mini-break - magnificent beds, rainfall showers, and design-forward interiors - whilst offering a quirky alternative to holiday cottages.

feeds.title: Harnser's Travels
feeds.description: This blog is a travel log of Narrowboat Harnser and states about the experiences of the quality time spent on the boat.

feeds.title: Percy
feeds.description: Hi! I am Nev and welcome to my narrowboat blog. This blog is a chronicle of ownership of narrowboat Percy and life in general. For the boater and the gongoozler alike.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Just Heaven
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Steve. The blog is all about the waterways wanderings of Narrowboat 'Just Heaven', a 55ft semi-trad narrowboat, built-in 2003. It is currently moored at Cropredy Marina on the Oxford canal.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Oleanna
feeds.description: Narrowboat Oleanna is intended as a diary of our travels on NB Oleanna for us to be able to look back on in years to come. Please feel free to follow us on our journey as we meet up with old friends, make new ones, and watch the seasons change around us.

feeds.title: Floating Our Boat Blog
feeds.description: Hi, we are Fran and Rich, we love writing the journal about the narrowboat Laura Maisie. So we thought we'd share with you our thoughts, ideas, passions, and reflections about our daily life.

feeds.title: The Purple Boat Blog
feeds.description: Hello! Welcome to Purple Boat Blog. The boat is built for a purpose, that is to fulfilling wanderlust, and was named 'Kwa Heri' which means 'Goodbye' in Swahili, to reflect their love of travel. Hire The Purple Boat narrowboat for your self-catering holiday along the Trent & Mersey Canal. Enjoy the many pubs and restaurants on the towpath whilst traveling through beautiful countryside and villages. Perfect for 2 and can accommodate 4 people.

feeds.title: A Canuck on the Cut
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of a Canadian's narrowboat adventures on the historic inland waterways of the UK.

feeds.title: The Sumpners Afloat
feeds.description: Greetings! We are Paul and Kay Sumpner. The Sumpners Afloat Blog is about the Adventures on our narrowboat 'Old Nick' and was primarily intended as a place to share technical information about the build of our beloved narrowboat. But as the time passed by, the thrust of the blog changed to reflecting our real-life experiences of living aboard and cruising the waterways and rivers

feeds.title: Pete's Blog » Narrowboat
feeds.description: He writes like a diary, describing where he travels on canals, the scenery he sees, and what daily boat life is like.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Hire Blog
feeds.description: Plan the perfect narrowboat day out with expert tips, scenic routes, and hidden waterways. Explore the Grand Union Canal and beyond! Start your journey now.

feeds.title: Warwickshire Narrowboat Hire Blog
feeds.description: Dive into our Blogs for expert tips, and hidden gems along the waterways. Discover the essence of narrowboat living before your real canal adventure begins!

feeds.title: Seyella's Journey
feeds.description: In the Blogspot of Seyella's Journey read about the travels and tribulations of NB SEYELLA on the canals and rivers of England and Wales

feeds.title: Halfie
feeds.description: Hello! I am Halfie and welcome to my blog space. This blog is all about my journey and experiences on the narrowboat Jubliee as I venture through the canals of the United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Living On A Narrowboat
feeds.description: Hi! I am Paul. I've compiled a comprehensive list of marinas for those who are interested, and also added hundreds of pages of articles about narrowboats and the ins and outs of life on board, and all you need to know before considering Living On A Narrowboat.

feeds.title: Everything Canal Boats
feeds.description: Everything Canal Boats is the home of ABC Leisure Group Ltd and your gateway to everything you could need or want related to canal boats and boating throughout the United Kingdom. ABC Leisure Group Limited has been building and operating a hire fleet and providing full marina services to canal users for over 45 years, with a thorough experience of everything to do with narrowboats and boating holidays.

feeds.title: Travelling the Canals of England
feeds.description: Hello! We are Ian and Helen, and this travel blog is an account of the travels of Narrowboat 'Leo' on the English waterways.

feeds.title: Golden Boyz Narrowboat Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the blog of the narrowboat Golden Boyz with 4 shipmates; Sandra, Barney, Cosmo & Daquiri, and their adventures. The Doggie Boat sells doggie-based gifts, toys, and other practical items for both doggies & humans from a narrowboat that tours boating festivals & moors in popular dog walking spots.

feeds.title: NB Holderness
feeds.description: Hi! We are Tony and Helen. Welcome to our narrowboat Holderness blog where we write about our journey, experiences, events, and much more.

feeds.title: Jannock
feeds.description: Welcome to Jannock's blog. This blog is about all the trips that our beloved narrowboat has made, and that too coming from its various members of the crew along with other interesting canal-related snippets.

feeds.title: Narrowboat Wrens-Nest
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to Wrens-Nest Blog, it's all about us, Chris and Joy, and our adventures living and traveling on our narrowboat. We tend to post mostly in the summer months when we are out and about enjoying the canals and occasionally rivers too. Read about our journey, different places, food, unexpected events, and more.

feeds.title: Escape the Rat Race Blog
feeds.description: Escape the Rat Race is one of the leading providers of long-term liveaboard narrowboats. We were amongst the first to specialize in long-term canal boat breaks. We have now been supporting clients to 'liveaboard' for 15 years and love nothing more than helping people to discover the waterways and make them their homes.

feeds.title: On the Road
feeds.description: Hello! We're Steve and Blanche and welcome to our blog. If adventure, travelling, wine & gastronomy thrown together with some laughter, and sun-filled camping are your cup of tea then you are at the right place.

feeds.title: Elms Mooring Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Elms Mooring Blog, a place where you can find blogs on travel experiences. Elms Moorings is a family-run business. For boat moorings across the UK, Elms Moorings has a prime location with the very best in local amenities and attractions. We are one of the Leading Marinas in the UK.

feeds.title: Boatwif
feeds.description: The Boatwif blog provides you with the experiences and the occasional adventures of the Cleddau crew. Read about the latest and upcoming sailing adventures, boats, different places, events, and more all on Boatwif.
